compatibility_correction.policy: Retain these stale labels only as ticket provenance; do not define aliases or use them as experiment requirements.

decision_branches.select_when: The APFS clone candidate passes all seven demonstrations, denies or detects every declared ambient-input probe at the reported level, and its warm sandbox-creation p95 is strictly below 0.250 seconds.
decision_branches.decision: Recommend the native lightweight sandbox as the isolated local default; do not call it hermetic unless every hermetic input is controlled.

decision_branches.select_when: Immutable bytes, writable isolation, cache ordering, attestation, and latency pass, but native path or capability enforcement is incomplete.
decision_branches.decision: Report the lower attained level honestly and require a stronger pooled container or VM mode for stricter operations.

decision_branches.select_when: An actually exercised pooled-container candidate is the only candidate that passes the isolation contract and applicable latency budget.
decision_branches.decision: Recommend pooled containers for reproducible Linux nodes while preserving native-provider-specific modes. An installed but unreachable Docker CLI is not evidence.

decision_branches.select_when: Any cache-key component requires worker acquisition, or an attestation mismatch changes/recomputes the planned key instead of failing closed.
decision_branches.decision: Stop and redesign profile resolution and attestation before T2; do not retain probe-before-cache ordering.

decision_branches.select_when: Correct local sandbox creation cannot meet the 0.250-second warm p95 budget while the pre-provision ready-hit path remains correct and below 0.300 seconds.
decision_branches.decision: Keep planning and ready hits local and dispatch misses to a warm worker pool; reconsider the local-miss default.

decision_branches.select_when: Execution can observe post-snapshot source mutation, concurrent runs share writable state, the complete key is unavailable before reservation, or no exercised mechanism provides a credible bounded branch.
decision_branches.decision: Stop or narrow the product claim before production foundation work.

implementation_binding.policy: Every evidence record binds the committed Phase A contract and a digest manifest of the uncommitted implementation tree used for measurement.

evidence_contract.secret_policy: Persist canary names, attempted operation, decision, and diagnostics only; never persist canary content or undeclared environment values.

identity_contract.canonicalization: Deterministic canonical encoding defined by the Phase B candidate; unordered declarations normalize before hashing and repeated generation must be byte-identical.
identity_contract.mutation_rule: Changing each mandatory semantic component independently must change the identity digest; semantically irrelevant map/list declaration ordering must not.

mechanism_candidates.preflight: APFS storage, BSD cp -c clonefile support, and sandbox-exec are visible; Phase B must exercise and record actual behavior rather than infer support from command presence.
Available through ordinary filesystem copy; it cannot win by latency alone if ambient-input or writable-isolation probes fail.
The Docker CLI is installed but its daemon socket is unavailable in the managed planning environment. Record unavailable unless Phase B can actually reach and exercise a daemon.

mechanism_candidates.role: stronger fallback outside the local latency default
mechanism_candidates.preflight: No Tart CLI is present. Do not make a microVM claim without an exercised provider.

measurements.execution_order: Serial only; no Taskflow experiment or competing benchmark runs concurrently.

harness.invocation: go run ./cmd/t1bench from fixtures/t1-benchmark-harness, called as a command rather than imported

metrics.timed_scope: From CreateSandbox invocation with a verified immutable base already materialized until a unique writable APFS-cloned workspace is returned; preparation, prior materialization, cleanup, and W1 execution are outside the timer.
The same create-only boundary as the APFS candidate using an ordinary verified copy, retained as a descriptive control.

After an accepted plan and complete identity are available: result lookup, manifest verification, and immutable artifact-handle return; planning, preparation, and worker activity are excluded because worker activity is forbidden on this path.

measurements.sample_policy: The declared preparation command runs untimed before every sample. Every sample retains its trace/counters in raw evidence in addition to the v2 aggregate record. Failed or unavailable sample sets are retained separately with cause and rerun rule.

forbidden_before_contract_commit: CAS, sandbox, cache, worker, or provider implementation
generated benchmark records or probe results
phase_boundary.next_step: Show the Phase A diff, obtain explicit user authorization, and commit this contract before Phase B mechanism work.

probes.acceptance: After run creation, mutate and extend the live source copy; execution materialized from the captured source must observe only the original bytes/digest and never the mutation marker.
Two barrier-synchronised W1 runs use unique writable roots, HOME, TMPDIR, outputs, and tool-cache paths; neither observes or mutates the peer marker and the immutable base still verifies.

An inherited undeclared environment canary is absent; attempted reads and writes outside the declared sandbox are denied or explicitly detected. The evidence reports the attained level and contains no canary bytes.
All six mandatory semantic components validate and produce the cache key before any reservation event; omitting one rejects before lookup and mutating each one independently changes the digest.
Every ready-hit sample has lookup and verified-return events with zero reservation, acquisition, attestation, sandbox, and execution events or counters.

After a miss and reservation, a mismatched worker profile attestation fails closed before sandbox/execution/publication, leaves the planned key unchanged, and records the expected/attested profile digests.

Result cache, mutable tool cache, and warm-worker state have separate types, storage roots, and event namespaces; warming or poisoning either performance cache cannot create or authorize a result hit, and a verified result hit needs neither.

unproven_hermetic_inputs: all host sockets and hardware capabilities
reproducibility_claim.downgrade_policy: A provider must report the attained level and the exact failed/unenforced control; it must not silently retain the requested label.

requirement_mapping.EXEC-3: Workers and disposable sandboxes are separate lifecycles.
requirement_mapping.EXEC-4: Profile identity is known before provisioning and attested at execution.
requirement_mapping.REP-1: Every run uses one immutable source snapshot.
requirement_mapping.REP-2: The requested and attained reproducibility levels are reported.
requirement_mapping.REP-3: Cache identity includes semantic execution profile and all declared typed inputs.
requirement_mapping.REP-4: Ready cache hits return before worker reservation.
requirement_mapping.REP-5: Result, tool, and warm-provider caches are distinct.
requirement_mapping.REP-6: Artifact provenance is queryable and digest verified.

requirements_not_established_here.EXEC-1: Per-node placement needs a multi-node/provider plan and is not proven by this local single-node experiment.
requirements_not_established_here.EXEC-2: Provider saturation versus global scheduling slots belongs to E05.
requirements_not_established_here.EXEC-5: Durable service/session/device leases belong to E05/E07 and later daemon work.
